docs: Clean-room stagger. No Motion UI or Motion+ source. StaggerItem has to be a direct child. Reduced motion shows every child at once, using motion-preference. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite motion-preference, motion.ts, or another file the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors.
